text:
Maya (Platform): Thanks everyone — quick live thread for follow-ups from today's all-hands on the reliability incident. RCA here: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-42 :link:

Maya (Platform): TL;DR: root cause = autoscaler race on dedicated pools + a bad model-variant fallback. Action items listed in the doc, but calling out a few owners now.

Evan (SRE): Raj, can you confirm the fix for the autoscaler is in staging? also any perf regressions expected?

Raj (Reliability Lead): yes, fix is in staging. main change reduces scale-down frequency and adds a mutex around pool reconciliation. no perf regressions on synthetic load. plan to promote to canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

Ben (Product): From roadmap side — will the canary require a market-facing config change? customers using Dedicated need to be informed?

Raj (Reliability Lead): No customer config changes required. internal only. I'll send a short note to customer success pre-canary. @Ben please review the blurb by EOD.

Lina (Eng): adding a small follow-up: we should add a quick repro test to the integration suite. proposing this snippet in infra-tests:

`````
# simulate flapping GPU nodes
for i in range(10):
  kill_node('gpu-1')
  wait(30)
  start_node('gpu-1')
`````

Lina (Eng): I'll open a PR with the test + a comment referencing the RCA (INC-2026-42).

Evan (SRE): oncall-bot: create incident-ops task for postmortem action items please

oncall-bot: Created TASK-6298 and assigned to Raj, Lina. Due 2026-04-05.

Ben (Product): Quick Q for leadership — are we adjusting our P99 latency SLOs for Dedicated while autoscaler changes roll out? want to set expectations for customers.

Maya (Platform): Leadership decision: hold current SLOs. we'll narrow maintenance windows and notify customers proactively. If the canary shows degradation, we'll push a short maintenance advisory — Ben, coordinate with CS.

Raj (Reliability Lead): I'll post a short deployment plan in #eng-releases later today and add rollback steps. @Lina, can you include the integration test link in the plan?

Lina (Eng): yes, will include. PR link when ready: https://git.redwood/integration-tests/pull/214

Ben (Product): Thanks — I'll draft the customer email and ping CS for review. :thumbsup:

Maya (Platform): Action summary: Raj (promote canary, deployment plan) due 2026-03-25; Lina (integration test + PR) due 2026-03-24; Ben (customer comms) due 2026-03-25; Raj & Lina assigned TASK-6298. If anything slips, flag here. Thanks everyone.
